links.comparator_used: Primary care provider referral to Wilmer Eye Institute (usual care) without autonomous AI screening
links.outcome: Presentation to eye care specialist care after referral, particularly among African-American patients
links.effect: Autonomous AI-assisted screening associated with increased presentation to eye care by African-Americans (p = 0.02); inverse-probability-weighted regression with propensity score matching, n = 3745
links.quote: An inverse-probability-weighted regression, which incorporated propensity score matching on social determinants of health and relevant clinical variables, showed that implementation of an autonomous AI-assisted diabetic screening program in a primary care clinic was associated with increased presentation to eye care specialist care by African-Americans (p = 0.02).

design_hint: point-of-care autonomous AI screening program in primary care (vs provider referral)
